caption:
This is the part listing photos never show you: the flood zone. In a high-risk flood area, the odds of a flood are at least 1 in 4.

That's over a 30-year mortgage. Before you make an offer, look up the address on FEMA's flood map. Read the seller's flood disclosure. Get a flood insurance quote early. Most homeowners policies don't cover floods.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
Talk to a real estate attorney about your situation.
